versions.content: Service Name V2x M_ Set Tolling Zone Information Syntax void V2x M_ Set Tolling Zone Information ( sint32 protected Zone Latitude, sint32 protected Zone Longitude, uint32 protected Zone Radius, uint8 protected Zone ID ) Service ID [hex] 0x10 Sync/ Async Synchronous Reentrancy Reentrant Parameters (in) protected Zone Latitude Latitude of the tolling zone protected Zone Longitude Longitude of the tolling zone protected Zone Radius radius of the protected zone in meter, use default value of 55m if not known protected Zone ID ID of the tolling zone, use 0x FFFFFFFF if not known Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value None Description Set available tolling z one information. This is done from V2x Fac that receives this information via CAM messages. Available via V2x M.h
